correctness.rationale: The four exact Groebner ideal membership tests per chart force all geometric singularities to be F5-rational and reduced; exhaustive search finds 65 ordinary nodes with nonzero Hessian determinants. Complete GF5/GF25 point enumeration including independent square-weight count yields 91/1651. Crepant node resolution, K²=24, chi=11, b2=106, and equality of 3276 to the GF25 Weil bound force second cohomology eigenvalues +5 (92) and -5 (14), establishing both exact zeta formulas. The embedded standalone checker was rerun successfully; no unproved finite-to-infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The ramified golden-ratio prime five is a natural, intrinsically motivated bad-reduction test for Barth’s extremally nodal sextic. Persistence as 65 individually F5-split rational double points and saturation of the full 106-dimensional Weil bound over F25 are geometrically and arithmetically strong phenomena. The resulting general-type surface Frobenius spectrum and zeta formulas are genuinely informative invariants not implied by the old complex geometry.
